beats.say: France's longest land border isn't in Europe.
beats.title: FRANCE'S LONGEST BORDER ISN'T IN EUROPE

beats.say: French Guiana, in South America, is not a colony. It is a full part of France, using the euro, and part of the European Union.
According to the CIA World Factbook, the border with Brazil runs six hundred forty nine kilometers. Just ahead of Spain.
Add islands in the Caribbean, the Indian Ocean and the Pacific, and France ends up with twelve time zones. More than any other country.
The sun never really sets on France. Follow for more.
beats.title: THE SUN NEVER SETS ON FRANCE
